meta.parties: Abdul Rahiman Et Al. v. Kani Umma Et Al

rules.statement: A translation of a deed would not be admissible as secondary evidence to prove the contents of the original deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "A translation of a deed of conveyance would not be admissible as secondary evidence to prove the contents of the original deed. Section 63 of the Evidence Ordinance is exhaustive of the different kinds of secondary evidence that are admissible to prove the contents of a document."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 63 of the Evidence Ordinance, or null
